This '''[[RA-7 protocol droid/Legends|RA-7 protocol droid]]''' was seen on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
This protocol [[Droid/Legends|droid]], along with an [[R4 astromech droid/Legends|R4 astromech droid]], could be found in a dark alley in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Lower market districts/Legends|lower market districts]]. When the [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] [[HELIOS-3D/Legends|HELIOS-3D]] and [[Todo 360/Legends|Todo 360]] were pursuing [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] under orders from [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]], HELIOS-3D accidentally [[Stun/Legends|stunned]] the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], confusing it with R2. This droid noticed the attack and started running away.
